title: IntakeBundle
description: Output of the Intake worker: validated and enriched product identity.

display_name.description: Human-readable product name (e.g. Aspose.Cells for Python).

canonical_import.description: Canonical import statement for the product (e.g. import aspose.cells).

runtime_import.description: Runtime module import path (e.g. aspose.threed). May differ from canonical_import.

repo_sha.description: Git SHA of the repository HEAD, pinned at intake time.

repo_dir.description: Filesystem path to the cached clone directory.

acquisition_confidence.description: TC-5321: Overall identity resolution quality (high/medium/low or empty).

import_confidence.description: TC-5321: Confidence that canonical_import matches repo truth (high/medium/low/none or empty).

canonical_import_candidates.description: TC-5321: Top import candidates extracted directly from repo source files.

repo_signals.description: TC-5321: Repo health signals (readme_present, is_empty_clone, license_detected, etc.).

is_fresh_clone.description: TC-5321: True if the repo was freshly cloned (not served from cache).
